SUN LDS vs WEL FIR — how the model reads this fixture

A hundred balls instead of a hundred and twenty compresses every phase of the innings. There are twenty fewer balls to recover from a poor start, so the cost of a slow powerplay is higher than it would be in a T20 and the death-overs arithmetic arrives sooner.

That is why the number above is only a starting point. From the first ball, the model works from balls remaining and required rate, and infers pitch behaviour from the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern rather than assuming a venue average. A chase that looks behind on paper at Sophia Gardens is often still very much alive.
